record.field: Create a helpdesk ticket. Use for incidents, anomalies and actions that need traceability. The ticket automatically gets the tags "infrastructure" and the given service name.
Document an infrastructure anomaly. Use for deviations that are not acute alerts but should be tracked — e.g. unusual CPU patterns, growing disk usage, or recurring warnings.

async def execute(title, description, minion="", metric=""): """Document an anomaly as a low-priority helpdesk ticket.""" anomaly_desc = description if minion: anomaly_desc += f"

Minion: {minion}" if metric: anomaly_desc += f"
Metric: {metric}" anomaly_desc += "

Type: Infrastructure Anomaly (non-critical)"
ticket = env["helpdesk.ticket"].create({ "name": f"[ANOMALY] {title}", "description": anomaly_desc, "priority": "0", # Low priority for anomalies }) return f"Anomaly documented: {ticket.name} (ID: {ticket.id})"
